quarterly_data.quarter: Uber press release: WeRide, Uber and AVOMO Receive Spain's First National (09-10-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Partner WeRide: WeRide, Uber and AVOMO (the autonomous vehicle division of Moove Cars Group) received Spain's first national permit for Level 4 autonomous passenger vehicles on public roads (company claim of 'first'; DGT ES-AV framework), authorizing testing of WeRide's GXR vehicles and mapping in the Madrid region; the initial phase will deploy twenty vehicles under the supervision of an in-car vehicle specialist. The Spain launch represents the fourth of the 15 cities under the WeRide-Uber strategic partnership, with another 11 cities to come by 2030, and under the partnership the companies plan to deploy tens of thousands of autonomous vehicles. Commercial operations in Spain are expected to begin by the end of 2026 - the first planned Uber-WeRide AV deployment in Europe.
quarterly_data.figure: twenty vehicles in the initial phase; fourth of the 15 cities; another 11 cities by 2030; tens of thousands of autonomous vehicles; commercial operations expected by the end of 2026
